headnotes.text: Nondiscriminatory local highway-safety rules that incidentally burden interstate commerce are judged by weighing the safety benefit against the burden, with a strong presumption of validity. headnotes.text: An arbitration award is not final if the arbitrators did not intend it as a complete determination of every claim submitted, so arbitrators may later make a supplemental award of interest on a submitted claim they had not decided. A finding that the original award was not meant to decide the interest claim is reviewed for clear error.
